title: Api proposal: currentRefinementsList widget
body:
The goal is to be able to list the current refinement and delete them one by one or all at one time. Example from Jadopado : ![capture d ecran 2015-09-22 a 11 48 39](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/1689007/10015385/205abb20-6120-11e5-8c5c-2923f71f6f3d.png) ``` search.addWidget( instantsearch.widgets.currentRefinementsList({ container: '#current-refinements', //clearAllButon // true or false //template }) ); ``` Resulting dom would look something like: ```
Clear All
Men x
Nike x
``` What do you think ?
